name: hands_on_head_hold
text: Stand holding both hands against the sides and top of the head in dismay, elbows wide. Hold this protective distressed pose with subtle breathing only.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 双手保持在额头两侧上方，肘部外张，微动两秒循环；延续一次性版本的手头接触限制，未宣称皮肤贴合。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
